title: Title & Registration Services Late-Penalty Reimbursement: Addition for Prompt Return of Documents
content:
On a Title & Registration Services late-penalty reimbursement, the reimbursed share is raised by one twentieth (0.05) when the order's latest document was received within half of the customer document due days counted from the opening date, by one fiftieth (0.02) when it was received later but within the due days, and by nothing otherwise. The share as raised never exceeds one; the reimbursement is the reimbursable penalty multiplied by it and rounded half up to the cent only at the end.

The days are counted in calendar days from the title order's opening date to the date of its latest document entry.

| Service type | Customer document due days | Half of the due days | 0.05 when received within | 0.02 when received after that but within |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Title-Only Service | 10 | 5 | 5 days | 10 days |
| Kestrel In-State Plate Transfer | 10 | 5 | 5 days | 10 days |
| Kestrel In-State New Registration | 10 | 5 | 5 days | 10 days |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration | 14 | 7 | 7 days | 14 days |
| Kestrel Out-of-State Registration with Inspection | 21 | 10.5 | 10 days (10.5 not being a whole day) | 21 days |
| Kestrel Specialty Plate Registration | 14 | 7 | 7 days | 14 days |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, Kestrel Out-of-State Registration, opened 1 May)

| Latest document received | Days after opening | Addition |
|---|---|---|
| 8 May | 7 | 0.05 |
| 9 May | 8 | 0.02 |
| 15 May | 14 | 0.02 |
| 16 May | 15 | nothing |
